messages:
Hanna (Partnerships): SpectralEdge sent their marketplace bundle. Need quick review: logo fallbacks, co-brand lockup spacing, and permission for a customer quote in the solution brief.
FileBot: Files uploaded: spectral_logo.svg, spectral_lockup_guidelines.pdf, spectral_case_acme.pdf, spectral_thumbnail.psd
Leo (Design): Opening guidelines  primary issue: they use a clipped mask and a soft gradient. Marketplace forbids masks that crop marks; gradients OK but provide a flat-color fallback for <=32px icons. I can export: spectral_badge_flat.svg and spectral_badge_mono.png.
Ivy (PMM): For the marketplace one-liner they proposed: "SpectralEdge + Redwood: fast inference for vision workflows." Suggest conservative copy: "SpectralEdge + Redwood: inference for vision at scale." Two-line co-authorship option ready if needed.
Mark (Legal): On the case PDF, I need the separate signed consent page. If the quote is in the case file but no explicit signed release, request a consent PDF. Without it we can't reuse the quote on partner marketplaces.
Hanna (Partnerships): I pinged SpectralEdge for a separate consent PDF and a shadowless SVG. Leo, please add an alt_text_en.md with canonical alt text.
Leo (Design): Will do. Adding README snippet: "Do not add masks or crop the mark. Clearspace = 24px. Provide flat fallback for icons." ETA 90m for exports and README.
FileBot: Reminder scheduled: publish-ready-review in 24h for partners/spectraledge/thread/2112123456
Mark (Legal): If SpectralEdge supplies signed consent covering "marketing and third-party marketplaces" we'll be good. Otherwise, publish assets without the customer quote.
Ivy (PMM): Noted. I'll prep marketplace thumbnails (16:9) and conservative copy so we can submit even if quote is held back.
Hanna (Partnerships): Thanks team  update this thread when the consent PDF or shadowless SVG is uploaded. :thumbsup:
